stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, Shenyang Public Utility Holdings Company Limited engages in diverse activities within the People's Republic of China. These primarily include infrastructure construction and property development. Furthermore, the company extends its involvement to tourism and hotel development, coupled with property investment. Founded in 1999, its main office is situated in Shenyang, China.
